theory.title: Describir el aspecto físico y la personalidad
theory.explanation: Para describir el aspecto usamos be + adjetivo (She's tall) y have got + sustantivo (She's got curly hair). Para la ropa y los accesorios habituales usamos el Present Simple de wear (He wears glasses). What does ... look like? pregunta por el aspecto físico; What is ... like? pregunta por la personalidad o el carácter. Añade modificadores como quite, rather, very y a little para precisar la descripción. Puedes unir ideas con and, but y because.
theory.tip: No confundas look like (aspecto físico) con be like (personalidad). Recuerda la -s de la tercera persona: He wears glasses. / She has got dark hair.

patterns.label: Bloque 8 · Preguntar y describir
patterns.pattern: What does ... look like? / What is ... like?

patterns.label: Bloque 10 · Descripción conectada
patterns.pattern: be + adjective; have got + noun; wear + clothing
examples: She's tall, and she's got wavy hair.
He wears glasses because he needs them.

content.passage: My name is Olivia, and this is a short profile of my family. My older brother, Ben, is quite tall and slim. He's got short, dark hair and he wears glasses. He's confident and very friendly, so he makes friends easily. My sister, Lucy, is shorter than Ben. She's got long, wavy fair hair and a few freckles. She's a little shy at first, but she's very funny when you know her. They both enjoy sport, but they are different people. Ben is more outgoing than Lucy, while Lucy is more patient. I look like my mum because we've both got curly hair.

content.audioTranscript: At a family party, Emma introduces two cousins to her friend. Emma: This is my cousin Jack. He's quite tall and slim. Friend: What does he look like? Emma: He's got short, dark hair and he wears glasses. Friend: And what's he like? Emma: He's friendly and confident. This is my cousin Nina. She's shorter than Jack. She's got long, wavy hair and a few freckles. She's a little shy, but she's very funny. They both love music, but they are quite different.
